recipes.title: Vietnamese caramel chicken with cabbage, light
recipes.summary: Tender chicken thigh braised with fish sauce, ginger and a light caramel glaze, served with cabbage, carrots and a modest portion of rice.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken thigh, green cabbage, onion, carrot, garlic, ginger and spring onions in their listed forms.
Stir the fish sauce, rice wine, brown sugar, chicken broth, garlic, ginger and half the sesame oil into a braising liquid.
Cook the white rice until tender and fully steamed.
Brown the chicken thigh in the remaining sesame oil until coloured on several sides.
Cook the onion and carrot until the onion is soft and translucent.
Pour the braising liquid over the chicken thigh.
Simmer the covered chicken until the thigh is tender and deeply seasoned.
Cook the green cabbage in the braising sauce until tender but still structured.
Finish the Vietnamese caramel chicken with the spring onions.
Rest the chicken before serving it with the white rice.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the chicken and rice separately for up to 3 days. Reheat the braise gently until steaming. Freeze the chicken and cabbage mixture for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Chinese braised tofu with mushrooms, light
recipes.summary: Golden tofu, mushrooms and bamboo shoots braised in soy, rice wine, garlic and ginger, with extra cabbage and a smaller serving of rice.

steps.instruction: Prepare the tofu, mushrooms, shiitake mushrooms, bamboo shoots, green cabbage, onion, garlic, ginger and spring onions in their listed forms.
Stir the soy sauce, rice wine, vegetable broth, garlic and ginger into a braising liquid.
Cook the white rice until tender and fully steamed.
Heat the sesame oil in a wide non-stick pan.
Brown the tofu until golden on several sides.
Cook the onion, mushrooms and shiitake mushrooms until lightly browned.
Cook the bamboo shoots and green cabbage until the cabbage begins to soften.
Simmer the tofu and vegetables in the braising liquid until the sauce reduces slightly.
Finish the Chinese braised tofu with the spring onions.
Rest the braise before serving it with the white rice.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the tofu braise and rice separately for up to 3 days. Reheat gently until steaming. Freeze the braise for up to 1 month.

recipes.title: French chicken fricassee with mushrooms, light
recipes.summary: Tender chicken and mushrooms in a light thyme cream sauce, served with potatoes. Less cream and butter keep this French dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the chicken thigh, potato, mushrooms, leek, onion and garlic in their listed forms.
Simmer the potato until tender when pierced with a knife.
Melt half the butter in a wide heavy pan.
Brown the chicken thigh on several sides.
Cook the onion and leek in the remaining butter until soft and translucent.
Cook the mushrooms until their moisture evaporates and the edges turn golden.
Stir the garlic and thyme into the vegetables until fragrant.
Simmer the chicken thigh in the chicken stock until tender and cooked through.
Stir the heavy cream and whole milk into the sauce.
Simmer gently until the sauce lightly coats the chicken and mushrooms.
Stir the lemon juice and salt into the fricassee.
Rest the French chicken fricassee before serving it with the potato.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate the fricassee and potatoes separately for up to 3 days. Reheat gently without boiling hard. Freeze the fricassee for up to 1 month.

recipes.title: Greek baked cod with white beans, light
recipes.summary: Cod baked over white beans, zucchini, peppers and tomatoes with dill and lemon. Extra vegetables and less oil keep this Greek dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the cod, zucchini, bell pepper, onion, garlic and dill weed in their listed forms.
Coat the zucchini, bell pepper and onion with half the olive oil.
Roast the vegetables at 210°C until they begin to soften and colour.
Stir the tomatoes, canned, white beans, vegetable broth, garlic, dill weed and salt together.
Pour the tomato and bean mixture around the roasted vegetables.
Bake until the white beans are hot and the tomato sauce has thickened slightly.
Place the cod over the vegetables and brush it with the remaining olive oil.
Bake until the cod is opaque and flakes easily at the thickest point.
Spoon the lemon juice over the baked cod.
Rest the Greek baked cod before serving.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 2 days and reheat covered until the cod is hot. The dish is best fresh and is not recommended for freezing.

recipes.title: Spanish white bean and vegetable stew, light
recipes.summary: White beans, potatoes and vegetables simmered with tomatoes, paprika and thyme. Extra vegetables and less potato and oil keep this Spanish dinner lighter.

steps.instruction: Prepare the potato, green beans, bell pepper, carrot, onion, celery and garlic in their listed forms.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery until soft and translucent.
Stir the garlic, paprika, thyme and tomato paste into the vegetables until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, canned, potato, bell pepper, vegetable broth and salt.
Simmer the stew until the potato is nearly tender.
Add the white beans and green beans to the stew.
Simmer until the green beans are tender and the broth is rich and spoonable.
Rest the Spanish white bean and vegetable stew so the flavours settle.

recipes.storageNotes: Refrigerate for up to 4 days and reheat gently with a splash of vegetable broth. Freeze the stew for up to 3 months.
